factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of comprehensive income (12M): Net profit: -1,169 thousand (1.169 million) in 2025 vs -7,604 thousand (7.604 million) in 2024 (84.6% improvement). Earnings per share: -0.15 EUR in 2025 vs -0.97 EUR in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The 2024 result included a one-off, non-cash goodwill impairment of EUR 5.7 million; excluding that impairment, the annual net loss declined by 39% from EUR 1.92 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: ...excluding the one-off, non-cash impairment of goodwill amounting to EUR 5.7 million recorded at that time... annual net loss decreased by 39 percent to EUR 1.17 million, compared with EUR 1.92 million the year before last.

factual_claims.claim: The main business remained flight package tours.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment information: Flight package tours had the highest sales (EUR 145,120 thousand in 12M 2025) and was described as the main part of Company’s services in the Main activities section.

factual_claims.claim: Their sales decreased 15.0% to EUR 145.1 million, but segment sales profit rose 18.0% to EUR 12.2 million as the margin increased from approximately 1% to 8%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment information (12M): Flight package tours Sales: EUR 145,120 thousand (145.12 million), down 15.0% from 2024. Sales profit for segment: EUR 12,162 thousand (12.162 million), up 18.0% from 2024. Sales profit margin: 8% in 2025 vs 1% in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Coach sightseeing tours also improved modestly, while plane sightseeing tours weakened sharply, with segment sales profit falling 84.4% to EUR 135 thousand.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment information (12M): Sightseeing tours by coach Sales profit for segment: EUR 63 thousand in 2025 vs EUR 41 thousand in 2024 (modest improvement). Sightseeing tours by plane Sales profit for segment: EUR 135 thousand in 2025 vs EUR 864 thousand in 2024 (84.4% decrease).

factual_claims.claim: Other sales remained loss-making, generating a EUR 2.5 million segment loss, compared with EUR 2.2 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment information (12M): Other sales Sales profit for segment: -EUR 2,515 thousand (-2.515 million) in 2025 vs -EUR 2,237 thousand (-2.237 million) in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Operational efficiency improved, with the aircraft load factor rising 1.5 percentage points to 97.2%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: One of the key efficiency indicators, aircraft load factor, increased by 1.5 percentage points in 2025 to 97.2 percent, compared with 95.7 percent in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Long-haul and ski-trip load factors also increased materially.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: Load factors on long-haul destinations increased from 97.4 percent to 98.5 percent year on year... A significant improvement was also achieved in ski destinations, where load factor rose from 90.5 percent to 97.2 percent.

factual_claims.claim: Turkey remained the largest destination, although its share declined, while Egypt, Italy, Spain and long-haul destinations gained share.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Breakdown of group package travel sales by destinations (12M): Turkey 32.0% (down from 34.3% in 2024), Egypt 14.7% (up from 12.6%), Italy 4.3% (up from 3.2%), Spain 4.3% (up from 3.8%), Long hauls 4.8% (up from 4.1%).

factual_claims.claim: Early bookings for the 2026 summer season were 59% higher by December 2025 than a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: By December 2025, bookings for the 2026 summer season were 59 percent higher than in the previous year.

factual_claims.claim: The balance sheet strengthened in total assets and cash, but financial leverage increased.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of financial position: Total assets increased to EUR 43,380 thousand (43.38 million) in 2025 from EUR 39,450 thousand in 2024. Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 1,691 thousand (1.691 million) from EUR 394 thousand. Debt/equity ratio increased to 191.42% in 2025 from 121.16% in 2024.

factual_claims.claim: Cash rose to EUR 1.7 million from EUR 394 thousand, while total borrowings increased to EUR 12.9 million and the debt-to-equity ratio rose to 191.42%.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of financial position: Cash and cash equivalents: EUR 1,691 thousand (1.691 million) in 2025 vs EUR 394 thousand in 2024. Total borrowings (current + non-current): EUR 12,867 thousand (12.867 million) in 2025. Debt/equity ratio: 191.42% in 2025.

factual_claims.claim: Equity declined to EUR 6.9 million, and no dividends were paid.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of financial position: Total equity: EUR 6,863 thousand (6.863 million) in 2025. Dividends section: The Company neither announced nor paid dividends during the period January- December 2025.

factual_claims.claim: For 2026, management plans a similar or slightly higher programme, with continued emphasis on profitability, cost efficiency and expansion of the hotel portfolio.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: For 2026, we currently plan our travel programme at a similar or slightly higher level. Our objective is to continue delivering consistent profitability growth. To achieve this, we will focus on operational and cost efficiency, and we will expand our hotel portfolio by adding more attractively priced options...
